prompt: A box set to 300px wide is actually 340px because of padding and border.
why: Width plus padding plus border makes the real size. That's the box model.
trap: Layout tools didn't change it; the box sizes did.

prompt: Adding box-sizing: border-box makes padding count inside the width.
why: This changes how the box model adds up sizes.
trap: It's a CSS rule, but its effect is on box sizes.

prompt: The space between two cards comes from the margin on each card.
tells: comes from the margin on each card
why: Margin is the space outside a box. That's the box model.
trap: A flex gap could do it too, but here it's margin.

prompt: The button looks cramped, so more padding is added around its text.
tells: more padding is added around its text
why: Padding is the space inside the border.
trap: It's a button, but the clue is the spacing inside it.

prompt: Two paragraphs with 20px margins are only 20px apart, not 40px.
why: Vertical margins between blocks collapse into one. That's a box model rule.
trap: No rule overrides another; margins merge.

prompt: Long text spills out of its fixed-height box.
tells: spills out of its fixed-height box
why: Content bigger than its box overflows. That's the box model.
trap: Phones make it likely, but the clue is the box size.
